transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic, what brings you in to see us today?

Um, well... I feel like people at work are secretly plotting against me, even when they tell me they’re not. It's gotten really hard to handle, and my husband and manager thought I should come talk to someone.
Can you tell me more about what makes you think people at work are plotting against you, and have you experienced any other unusual thoughts or beliefs recently?

I constantly see the other servers and even some of the regulars trading these little looks, and I'm convinced they're changing my order tickets to make me look bad. Even when my manager shows me the tickets are fine, I still have this strong gut feeling that there's a secret plan to get me fired. As for other thoughts, I'm not really sure, it's just mainly this happening at work.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts about people plotting against you, and have they been limited to just your workplace or have they started to involve other areas of your life?

These feelings of people plotting against me have been happening regularly for about four months now. They are really just focused at my workplace with the other servers and regulars, and haven't spread to other areas of my life, though the stress of it is very constant.

Have you experienced any episodes where you felt like you were receiving special messages or had a special mission, or have your beliefs about the plot against you been fairly consistent and focused on the idea that others are out to harm you?

No, I don't have any special mission or get any messages like that. My thoughts are really consistent and just focused on my job, where I have this strong gut feeling that they are trying to ruin things for me and get me fired. It's just about them trading looks and trying to make me look bad.

Have you ever taken any actions based on these beliefs, such as confronting your coworkers or trying to gather evidence of the plot, or have you been able to maintain a distance from these thoughts and recognize they might not be based in reality?

I haven't openly confronted my coworkers about it, but I find it completely impossible to distance myself from these thoughts. Even when my manager shows me proof that there's nothing wrong with the order tickets, I still feel deep down in my gut that there is a hidden plan to get me fired.
Have you ever had a period of time where you did not believe people were plotting against you at work, or has this belief been constant over the past four months?

No, it has been completely constant over the last four months and hasn't really gone away at all. Even when my manager tries to show me there's nothing wrong with the tickets, I still feel deep down in my gut that they're plotting to get me fired. It's just there every single shift I work.
Have you experienced any significant impairment in your social or occupational functioning as a result of these beliefs, such as difficulty interacting with coworkers or performing your job duties?

Yes, my work has slipped so much that I’ve been written up several times and almost fired. Outside of work, I’m avoiding my friends and letting my husband handle all the bills, errands, and talking to family because I just feel too overwhelmed to keep up.
Have you experienced any hallucinations, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others cannot, in addition to your beliefs about the plot against you at work?

Yes, I do hear things quite often, especially at work and late at night. I'll hear my name being called or a couple of voices whispering that I'm screwing things up and don't deserve my job, even when I can see the kitchen is quiet and there's nobody near me.
Can you describe the voices you hear in more detail, such as how often they occur, what they say, and if they comment on your thoughts or actions?

They happen pretty regularly, especially over the last four months, mostly when I'm at work or late at night when everything is quiet. The voices whisper my name and say things like I'm screwing up and don't deserve my job. It's really unsettling because I'll hear them clearly even when there is absolutely nobody around me.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your behavior or thinking patterns over the past four months, such as becoming more disorganized or having difficulty making decisions?

Yes, things have definitely gotten a lot more chaotic and hard to manage over the last few months. Sometimes during a busy rush I'll just freeze up at the server station, staring blankly at the tickets or pacing back and forth and compulsively rearranging the silverware. It's really embarrassing because I get so overwhelmed that I just can't seem to focus or do my job.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by 'freezing up' at the server station, and have you experienced any other episodes of disorganized or compulsive behavior outside of work?

When I freeze up, I'll just stand there holding a tray or staring at the tickets while people are trying to talk to me, and I literally cannot move or respond. Sometimes instead of working, I'll just start pacing back and forth or repeatedly rearranging the silverware over and over. Outside of work, I haven't really had these freezing or compulsive behaviors; I'm mostly just inactive and sit on the couch or in the yard.

Can you clarify if the voices you hear and the episodes of freezing up or compulsive behavior are related to your beliefs about the plot against you, or if they seem to occur independently of those thoughts?

I'm not entirely sure how they all connect, but they all seem to happen around the same time when I am feeling really overwhelmed at work. When the pressure builds up and I feel like they are plotting against me, that's usually when I start hearing the whispers and just freeze up.
Can you describe any instances where your thoughts seemed disjointed, or you had trouble following a logical sequence of ideas, especially during times when you felt overwhelmed at work?
I'm not really sure about my thoughts being disjointed or out of order. It's more that when things get busy, I just freeze up physically and get completely stuck and overwhelmed.

Have you ever experienced a time when your thoughts felt like they were racing, or you had trouble keeping track of what you were thinking or saying, especially during those moments of feeling overwhelmed at work?
No, I don't really experience racing thoughts. Instead, my mind actually feels like it goes completely blank and freezes up when I get overwhelmed at the server station.

Can you think of any times when you had trouble understanding what was being said to you, or when you had difficulty expressing your thoughts in a way that made sense to others, especially during those moments of feeling overwhelmed?

I'm not really sure, and I haven't really noticed having trouble making sense of things or understanding others. It's more that my mind just goes blank and I freeze up physically when I get too overwhelmed, rather than having trouble with the words themselves.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts were not your own, or that someone or something was controlling your mind or thoughts, especially during those times when you felt overwhelmed and heard voices?

No, I don't think I've ever felt that way. My thoughts still feel like they are completely my own, it's just the whispering voices and the constant feeling that people are plotting against me that trouble me.
Can you think of any times when your thoughts seemed to be fragmented, or you jumped from one idea to another unrelated idea, especially when you were feeling overwhelmed or hearing the voices?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't really noticed my thoughts jumping around like that. It's more that when I get overwhelmed, my mind just goes completely blank and I freeze up.
Can you tell me more about how the voices you hear and your belief in the plot against you at work are connected, and do the voices ever comment on your thoughts or actions outside of the plot?

They feel deeply connected because the whispering voices specifically say I'm screwing things up and don't deserve my job, which really reinforces my belief that there is a plan to get me fired. Even when I hear them late at night at home, they still only focus on my work failures, so they don't comment on other unrelated thoughts or things I'm doing.

Can you think of any instances where you had trouble maintaining a coherent train of thought, or where your thoughts seemed to be disconnected from each other, especially during times when you were feeling overwhelmed or hearing the voices?

I haven't really noticed my thoughts being disconnected or had trouble keeping a coherent train of thought. I'm not really sure about that happening to me. For me, it's more that my mind just goes completely blank when I get overwhelmed.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your mood, such as feeling extremely happy or irritable, in addition to the voices and beliefs you've described?
No, I haven't really experienced those kinds of extreme mood changes. I definitely haven't felt unusually happy or high-energy, and I wouldn't say I've been highly irritable either.
Have you ever experienced a period where your beliefs about the plot against you at work seemed to lessen or go away, even if temporarily, or have they been consistently present since they started?

No, they haven't lessened or gone away at all; they have been consistently present ever since they started about four months ago. In fact, they've actually become much more intense and noticeable, especially during this recent busy season at the restaurant.
Can you describe any times when the voices you heard or your beliefs about the plot against you at work seemed to influence each other, or if they have always been separate experiences?

I'm not entirely sure how the voices and the plot influence each other or if they are separate. But they both happen around the same time at work, and together they just make me feel like I'm failing at my job.
Have you ever experienced any visual hallucinations, such as seeing things that others cannot, in addition to the voices you hear and the beliefs about the plot against you?

No, I've never seen anything unusual or had any visual hallucinations like that. My experiences have really just been hearing those whispering voices and feeling like people at work are plotting against me.

You've mentioned hearing voices and believing in a plot against you at work, but can you tell me if the voices you hear are ever critical of you, or if they only seem to reinforce your belief that others are plotting against you?

Yes, the voices are actually very critical of me and feel really personal and hurtful. They whisper about how I'm constantly screwing things up and that I don't even deserve to have my job. Hearing that all the time definitely reinforces my feeling that everyone at work is targeting me and wants me gone.

Can you think of any times when your thoughts seemed to be highly disorganized, or you had significant trouble making logical connections between ideas, especially during moments of high stress or when hearing the voices?

I haven't really noticed my thoughts being jumbled or having trouble making logical connections in that way. Though I do sometimes just freeze up or get completely overwhelmed when things get busy at work.

Have you ever experienced any episodes where you felt like you lost touch with reality, or where your perceptions of the world around you seemed to change dramatically, separate from the voices and plot beliefs you've described?

I don't think I've had any other experiences like that. My main struggles are really just the ones I've already talked about, like the whispering voices and that constant feeling that people at work are plotting against me.

Can you tell me if the voices you hear and your beliefs about the plot against you have ever led you to experience any significant episodes of confusion or disorientation, where you weren't sure what was real and what wasn't?

Yes, it gets incredibly confusing and overwhelming, especially during busy shifts. When I hear the voices and feel targeted, I just freeze up at the server station or pace around because I'm so unsure of how to react. Even when my manager shows me there is no actual issue with an order, that gut feeling that a plot exists makes it so hard to process what is actually real and happening around me.

Have you ever experienced a period where the voices you heard seemed to be commenting on your thoughts or actions in a way that was not related to the plot against you at work, or have they always been focused on that specific theme?

No, they have almost always been focused on the theme of me screwing up and not deserving my job. I hear them whispering about those work-related failures, especially when I'm at the restaurant or late at night. They really haven't commented on other unrelated thoughts or actions in my life.

Can you clarify if the voices you hear are always whispering critical comments about your work performance, or if there are any times when the voices say anything positive or neutral about you or other topics?

The voices are almost always negative and critical, focusing on how I am screwing things up or don't deserve my job. Sometimes it is just my name being called, which is neutral, but I have never once heard them say anything positive or supportive.
Can you describe if there have been any times when the voices you heard and your beliefs about the plot against you seemed to be triggered by any specific events, stressors, or substances?

Yes, it all started and got much worse after our restaurant went through a big ownership change and staff cuts, especially during the recent busy season when the pressure was just too much. I don't use any substances or drugs, so it really feels like the overwhelming stress and the fast pace of the job are what set everything off.
